ValidationRule.description: BOPI-592 The Billing contact is required before submitting for approval
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(ApprovalStatus__c), SBQQ__Account__r.Has_Billing_Contact__c = false, NOT(ISPICKVAL(SBQQ__Opportunity2__r.Type, "Auto Renewal")) ) && Quote_Val_Bypass__c = false
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You must have at least one Billing Contact related to the Account in order to submit for approval
